zh-CN.title: 空间入口会理解功能开关
items: 关闭聊天的空间现在会直接从广场开始，不再短暂进入聊天页
聊天入口与后台消息同步会随功能开关一起停用
通讯录保持独立可用，好友列表、申请与管理不受聊天开关影响

en.title: Space entry now respects feature settings
items: Spaces with chat disabled now open directly on Square without flashing the chat screen
Chat navigation and background message sync stop together with the feature
Contacts remain independent, so friend lists, requests, and management continue to work
